section_summary.extract_value: This section reports measurement invariance testing across sex in a single study with female (n=112) and male (n=141) subsamples. The unconstrained model showed adequate fit for females but poor-to-adequate fit for males. Factor loading invariance was achieved across sex, but intercept invariance was not fully supported, leading the authors to conclude that sex differences in mean scores were not evaluated.
